generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Ranks and selects a bounded, diverse opportunity portfolio using transparent criteria and records why other directions were deferred or rejected.

contract.purpose_user_function: Current code selects a bounded deterministic subset of non-blocked ideas; the described transparent multi-criteria diverse portfolio ranking is not fully implemented.
contract.valid_inputs: Candidate list, availability/duplicate status, source order, maximum idea count, and novelty/feasibility recommendations.
contract.expected_outputs: A bounded selected-candidate list with deterministic selection status; no rich portfolio scorecard or diversity objective is found.
contract.state_side_effects: Filters which candidates continue and records selected/not-selected status.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Blocked/duplicate candidates are excluded; empty eligible sets produce no portfolio. Multi-criteria conflict handling is not defined.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Supports maximum-count selection and screening recommendations; transparent strategic criteria, diversity optimization, and detailed defer/reject rationale are limited.
contract.success_evidence: Partial: `harness/plugins/autosci/backends/idea_source.py::_apply_max_ideas_selection` bounds selection; novelty review provides advance/revise/reject/inconclusive recommendations.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: Test max size, rank ordering, diversity, tie, advance/revise/reject, deferred rationale, empty pool, and sensitivity to each future criterion.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md#Appendix: AutoSci Commands (`/ideate`, `/novelty`); docs/integrations/autosci/full-parity-progress-report.md#Remaining Partial/Gated Routes documents incomplete global parity, provider-gated routes, and remaining semantic-proof gaps.
